text:
Omar: Quick ping  PR #4997 adds a new dashboard preset for sampling-rate and cost-per-sample, plus a compact tracing-hook migration note. Need docs reviewer for snippet audit + linkcheck. @DevEx Lina?
DevEx Lina: On it. Share staging preview pls.
Omar: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4997/preview. Changes: sampling-rate widget + cost-per-sample example, Rust + Elixir migration snippets for trace id rename, and a short note about sampling tradeoffs.
Anya (eng-runtime): Note: runtime v2.3 supports legacy `traceKey` for trace ingestion but dashboards/alerts should use `trace_id` going forward. Recommend a short compatibility paragraph.
SRE Kyle: Can infra run a tiny microbench for the sampling preset? PM wants a simple before/after single-line stat.
Rory (product): Suggested wording: "Illustrative: sampling reduced median latency 115ms -> 92ms, p99 280ms -> 245ms; est cost/sample $0.0038 -> $0.0031" with clear caveat.
DevEx Lina: Running smoke + linkcheck: `./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4997 --suite quick --linkcheck`
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4997 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Lina: Smoke OK. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (old-tracehook#examples). Commented on PR.
Omar: I'll patch the anchor and add a redirect note. Also adding a one-line checklist: upgrade SDKs to v3.6+ for auto-mapping; otherwise rename keys.
Anya (eng-runtime): Snippets: adding Rust + Elixir examples helps our adopters. For Rust show mapping from ctx.get("traceKey") -> ctx.get("trace_id"). For Elixir show Map access rename.
DevEx Lina: Drafted snippets in the PR comment: 
```rust
// old
span.set_tag("traceKey", ctx.get("traceKey"));
// new
span.set_tag("trace_id", ctx.get("trace_id"));
```
```elixir
# old
Span.set_tag(span, "traceKey", ctx[:traceKey])
# new
Span.set_tag(span, "trace_id", ctx[:trace_id])
```
SRE Kyle: Microbench (short): median ~20% improvement, p99 ~12% improvement, cost/sample down ~15%. Pushed numbers to PR. Added line: "Results vary by workload; run your own evals."
Rory (product): Add a tiny section under Console > Dashboards > Presets about sampling tradeoffs (accuracy vs cost) and link to the eval notebook. Keep numbers illustrative only.
Omar: Added tradeoffs blurb and backfilled a redirect to the old tracehook deep-dive. Requested reviews from @DevEx Lina, @SRE Kyle, @Anya (eng-runtime). Aiming to merge today.
DevEx Lina: Fixed anchor + pushed snippet formatting commit 9d7f. Re-ran linkcheck -> all green.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4997 -> staging (status: success)
DevEx Lina: Approved after CI green.
Omar: Merged to main and backported the migration note to the 3.x docs set. Closing thread  thanks everyone :tada:
